name: Original
thesis: Dark neon layout with dynamic energy glows, a 3D can scroll flight path, and an animated GSAP tachometer preloader.

name: Category Standard
thesis: Dark action-sports layout with a spotlit can over the pyramids, stacked Anton wordmark, stat-led arena rows, and slot-aligned can poses.

name: Aluminium
thesis: Brutalist identity program using silver and can-blue checkerboard quarter-panels with Anybody typography and slot-aligned can poses.

name: Midnight Swiss
thesis: Editorial Swiss design on a Red Bull navy field featuring a 12-column hairline grid, Archivo and Geist typography, index tables, and a single red accent.

name: Photo Annual
thesis: Sports-photography annual on white paper stock with uncropped photo plates, a captioned cover, pinned portrait strips, and dry-rendered can.

name: Sleek Carbon
thesis: Dark hardware-inspired interface with double-bezel framed panels, carbon-mesh gradients, floating glass islands, and minimalist typography.
